answer_1.quote: Simultaneous speech-to-speech translation (Simul‑S2ST), which involves generating target speech while concurrently receiving streaming speech inputs...
answer_1.outputs: target speech (generated via unit sequence and HiFi‑GAN vocoder)

answer_2.quote: We evaluate S2ST quality using ASR‑BLEU toolkit, which first transcribes the translated speech into text ... We also use BLASER 2.0 to assess the generated speech's quality ... We report word error rate (WER), BLEU score, 1‑gram accuracy, and latency metrics such as Average Lagging.
